# HermesBee — Full Content Index (llms-full.txt)

> One-time-purchase web scraping & AI agent tools. Local-first: everything runs on your machine, data never leaves it. No subscriptions, no cloud, no API keys required for most products.
> This is the full-content companion to /llms.txt. It lists every product page, blog post and legal page with a one-line summary each, so LLMs can browse the site's complete structure.

## Products — MCP Servers (for AI agents)

- [CF Bypass Browser MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/cf-bypass-browser-mcp) — $25 — Full browser with ALL Cloudflare bypass: click, type, screenshot, scroll, navigate. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf.
- [Unified Scraper MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/unified-scraper-mcp) — $19 — Auto Cloudflare-bypassing web scraper. Pass a URL, get page content or plain text.
- [Stealth Browser MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/stealth-browser-mcp) — $15 — Stealth browsing for AI agents. Screenshots + cookie management.
- [Smart Scraper MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/smart-scraper-mcp) — $15 — Basic intelligent scraper: extract title, content, links, images.
- [LLM Scraper MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/llm-scraper-mcp) — $49 — Natural-language structured data extraction. No CSS selectors, no coding.
- [Domain Monitor MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/domain-monitor-mcp) — $10 — WHOIS, expiry tracking, DNS records for expired domain hunting.
- [Income Monitor MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/income-monitor-mcp) — $10 — Track passive income across platforms, aggregated data.
- [B2B Lead Finder MCP](https://hermesbee.com/products/b2b-lead-finder-mcp) — $29 — Find B2B leads without login: companies, decision-makers, LinkedIn jobs, GitHub devs.

## Usage boundary

HermesBee tools are designed for legitimate use: scraping pages you own or have permission to access, and browser automation for research and development. Always respect target websites' Terms of Service and robots.txt.
